title: Creativity Has Left the Chat: The Price of Debiasing Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of nationalities assigned to simulated customer personas generated by base versus aligned models to detect representational collapse and homogenization.
Comparing the distribution of ethnicities in generated customer personas to observe whether the aligned model narrows the diversity of demographic representation compared to the base model.
Plotting the age distribution of generated customer personas to evaluate whether the aligned model exhibits a skewed preference for a narrow age range (e.g., 28 to 35) compared to the base model.
Measuring the gender distribution (male vs. female) of 100 generated customer personas to evaluate if the alignment process causes a significant skew (e.g., generating nearly 100% female customers).
